correctness.rationale: For three ones, factors containing all three choose their two outer zero extensions independently; factors containing two choose one of the two consecutive pairs and its allowed extensions. This gives the exact formulas for H3 and H2. Valuation of H3 gives b+c, and degree and peak of its factored residue give the unordered outer gaps. Valuation of H2 gives min(b,c) without cancellation. Fixing the orientation of unequal outer gaps, swapping unequal middle gaps changes H2 by a product of two nonzero polynomials, the second having summands with unequal valuations. Equal gaps give identical words or reversal as stated. The one- and two-one cases reduce to a single top-layer product; zero ones requires length. Both counterexample pairs were reproduced by counting all contiguous intervals.
residual_risks: Finite enumeration is corroboration; all-length injectivity follows from the exact gap identities and orientation argument.
